notes.title: Steam Deck Update Notes
notes.content:
Hello,

LEGO Builder's Journey now support touch input on [b]Steam Deck [/b]and [b]Intel Arc series 7 graphics cards[/b].

Thank you for your support and take care,
Light Brick Studio

[h2]— Patch Notes —[/h2][list]
[*]Optimized Graphics Settings - Low, Medium, High settings now use adjusted settings, for improved performance and image quality.
[*]Adjustments for ray traced reflections and ambient occlusion.
[*]Support for Intel A770 graphics cards. (Ray traced reflections use slightly different settings on A770)
[*][b]Touch input for Steam Deck.[/b] 
[*]Minor material adjustments on a few levels.
[/list]

tags.feature: Support for Intel A770 graphics cards. (Ray traced reflections use slightly different settings on A770)

notes.title: Public Preview Build - Steam Deck Touchscreen Support & more
notes.content:
Some of you have reported that the [b]LEGO Builder's Journey[/b] touchscreen controls are not working on [b]Steam Deck[/b], as it does natively on [b]Windows 10/11[/b]. Thanks to a player, we also received a report regarding issues between [b]LEGO Builder's Journey[/b] and [b]Intel Arc series 7 graphics cards.[/b] 

We want you to enjoy [b]LEGO Builder's Journey[/b], which is why our team worked to rolling out a preview build to fully support touch input on [b]Steam Deck [/b]and support for [b]Intel Arc series 7 graphics cards[/b].

We've setup a separate branch on Steam called “[i]preview - Public preview branch[/i]” that allows you to download this upcoming update and play [b]LEGO Builder's Journey[/b] with touchscreen controls on [b]Steam Deck[/b] and running our game on [b]Intel Arc series 7[/b] GPU.

Note that we have not completed our full round of quality assurance testing on this build, so there could be instances of instability that we have not identified yet. Still, if you're willing to help, please download this new build and let us know how it goes on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1544360/discussions/1/]Technical Support forum[/url].

[h3]To access the Public Preview branch, follow these steps:[/h3][olist]
[*] In your Steam library, right click on “[b]LEGO Builder's Journey[/b]” and select “[b]Properties[/b]”
[*] Select the “[b]BETAS[/b]” tab
[*] Change the drop-down to “[i]preview - Public preview branch[/i]”
[/olist]
If you do not see the branch in your drop-down, please restart your Steam client.

[h3]To switch back to the default branch, follow these steps:[/h3][olist]
[*] In your Steam library, right click on “[b]LEGO Builder's Journey[/b]” and select “[b]Properties[/b]”
[*] Select the “[b]BETAS[/b]” tab
[*] Change the drop-down to ‘none’[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297784/c317ef3fa28f1f18b4e3a45e484b898257132cb3.png[/img][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][list]
[*]Optimized Graphics Settings - Low, Medium, High settings now use adjusted settings, for improved performance and image quality.
[*]Adjustments for ray traced reflections and ambient occlusion.
[*]Support for Intel A770 graphics cards. (Ray traced reflections use slightly different settings on A770)
[*][b]Touch input for Steam Deck.[/b] 
[*]Minor material adjustments on a few levels.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for November 25
notes.content:
New in this release:

- Added support for AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution (FSR) that uses cutting-edge upscaling technologies to help boost the framerate  and deliver high-quality, high-resolution rendering, without having to upgrade to a new graphics card.
- Added graphics options to enable/disable: Sub-Surface Scattering, Film Grain, Chromatic Abberation, and Panini Projection.
- Performance improvements for all graphics  and ray tracing settings.
- Performance improvements for reflections and lighting.
- Minor adjustments to some levels.
